typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string (),
	userName as string ()
}

source(output(
		project as string,
		workbook as string,
		view as string,
		action as string,
		user as string,
		user_name as string,
		user_email as string,
		lastview as date,
		lastlogin as date,
		viewcount as decimal(18,0)
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(UploadDate = currentTimestamp(),
		ETLUser = $userName) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		workbook as string,
		view as string,
		user_email as string,
		UploadDate as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		ETLUser as string,
		user_name as string,
		lastlogin as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		project as string,
		action as string,
		lastview as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		viewcount as integer,
		user as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		workbook,
		view,
		user_email,
		UploadDate,
		ETLUser,
		user_name,
		lastlogin,
		project,
		action,
		lastview,
		viewcount,
		user),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
